heroHeadline: Battle of Al-Baraka Erupts in Blue Nile; North Kordofan War Crimes Condemned; South Darfur Tribal Violence Kills 50+
heroSubtitle: SAF's Fourth Infantry Division and a joint RSF/SPLM-N force fought for control of Al-Baraka garrison town in southern Blue Nile State (June 3–4), with both sides trading competing claims — the battle threatens the Roseires Dam corridor as SAF's Blue Nile counteroffensive enters its third month. Sudan's Justice Minister formally condemned RSF 'war crimes and crimes against humanity' in North Kordofan villages on June 3, following the Al-Murrah Eid massacre (60 dead); on the same morning an RSF drone struck legal administration buildings in El-Obeid. Tribal fighting between Salamat and Beni Halba communities in South Darfur's Kubum area killed at least 50 civilians by June 3, with RSF accused of arming one faction. SAF launched drone strikes on RSF positions in North Kordofan on June 3 and June 5 while intercepting a second RSF drone over White Nile State on June 5. Day 1147 of the SAF-RSF war with no ceasefire and 28.9 million projected acutely hungry at lean season peak.
